593:t_018:1.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$マリーダ$$! We'll protect you!!」

593:t_022:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Not just his... It's $$マリーダ$$'s... Everyone's... sorrow.」

593:t_022:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「What... have I...? What have I done...!?」

593:t_022:7.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「He... has no hostility left...」

593:t_022:12.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Master... Dad... chose to let go of hatred... For... the future...」

593:t_022:13.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「His... light... saves me... from sinking... into hatred...」

593:t_022:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'm sorry...! I... Back then, I...!!」

593:t_023:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「Why... did it come to this...?」

593:t_024:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Why...? Now should be their chance, while we're shaken...」

593:t_024:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
($$リディ・マーセナス$$... Your earnest heart hurts others and yourself... Calm down and look around you...)

593:t_024:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(The world is vast... So many people are resonating with one another...)

593:t_024:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Master, everyone in the $$ガランシェール$$ crew... and $$バナージ$$... taught... me that...)

593:t_024:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. Feel them through $$ユニコーン$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$.」

593:t_024:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Everyone in the $$ガランシェール$$ crew...!」

593:t_025:0.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I can... feel them, too...」

593:t_025:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「This great, warm light is...」

593:t_026:1.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$マリーダ$$! $$バナージ$$!」

593:t_026:3.en:
$$ベッソン$$
「The thought of drifting through space like that gives me chills.」

593:t_026:4.en:
$$フラスト$$
「Ha! Like hell we'd die here! Right, Captain!?」

593:t_026:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Yeah! I'm going to survive until I see $$マリーダ$$ in a wedding dress!」

593:t_026:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「You never give up, no matter what... You're a model sailor, Captain $$ジンネマン$$.」

593:t_027:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Ugh...! What is this feeling!?」

593:t_027:3.en:
$n
「Is Miss $$スズネ$$ inside $$アムブリエル$$ coming to the surface!?」

593:t_027:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...Tch...! Now another pest has shown up!」

593:t_028:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's stop this, Ensign $$リディ$$!」

593:t_028:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Shut up, $$バナージ$$! A kid like you gets praised as a $$ニュータイプ$$ and goes around making a mess of everything!」

593:t_028:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ニュータイプ$$s...! A human subspecies that embodies $$ラプラスの箱$$'s curse...! Someone has to sacrifice themselves to quell it!」

593:t_028:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「The $$マーセナス家$$ left the curse behind, and the $$ビスト家$$ kept it hidden...!」

593:t_028:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Only we, the heirs of those two families, can settle this tie!」

593:t_028:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「It wasn't supposed to be like this...! It was a prayer, not a curse! If only $$ニュータイプ$$s had never been born!」

593:t_028:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Calm down, $$リディ$$! The machine is swallowing you up!」

593:t_028:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「So what!? I'm trying to defeat a new humanity that seeks to evolve! Selling my soul to a machine is nothing...!」

593:t_028:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$リディ$$! Open your heart!」

593:t_028:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't you understand, Ensign $$リディ$$!?」

593:t_028:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're a $$ニュータイプ$$, too! The light of $$バンシィ$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$ is coming from inside you!」

593:t_029:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are drawn to those who emit $$脳量子波$$. Your strong feelings may be what called them here.」

593:t_029:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「And you have the power to master that $$バンシィ$$.」

593:t_029:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You should be able to hear them! Everyone's worried about you! $$オードリー$$, Ensign $$ミヒロ$$, and everyone!」

593:t_029:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Then I won't use words... But... Even so...!)

593:t_029:8.en:
$n
(You always helped me with my special training, Ensign. Let me repay you!)

593:t_029:9.en:
$$キラ$$
(You were willing to give your life fighting for Princess $$ミネバ$$. You're just like us...!)

593:t_029:10.en:
$$エマ$$
(Where did the man who wanted to prove himself without relying on the $$マーセナス家$$ go!?)

593:t_029:11.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
(A pilot lives by skill alone! Family, bloodlines - they can all eat shit!)
